Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL Database Hyperscale performance enhancements

Body.Content:
We are thrilled to announce some exciting performance enhancements for Azure SQL Database Hyperscale. Our latest updates push the boundaries of what's possible in relational data storage, delivering even greater speed, efficiency, and reliability.

One key improvement is the increased log generation rate, now boasting an impressive 150 MB/s, up from the previous 100 MB/s. This significant boost means faster data processing and greater throughput for your most demanding workloads.

We're also introducing the new continuous priming feature. This innovative caching mechanism ensures consistent performance levels even after a database failover. With continuous priming, you can expect minimal disruption and maximum efficiency, keeping your operations running smoothly.

These advancements reinforce our commitment to providing cutting-edge solutions that help you achieve your business goals. Explore the new capabilities of Azure SQL Database Hyperscale and experience the future of data management today.

Learn more.
